basics.name: Andor Sípos
basics.label: Founder, Technical Lead & Software Architect
basics.summary: Founder, technical lead and software architect of operandor, with 13+ years of experience developing business .NET systems. He helps business leaders, operations teams and technical leaders whose work is slowed by disconnected systems, repetitive data entry or applications that are difficult to extend. He develops custom business software, modernises existing .NET systems and integrates applications, primarily using .NET/C#, Azure and web technologies. As a hands-on developer and architect, he works with developers he has collaborated with on previous projects. He distinguishes AI automation built for clients' business processes from the AI tools used in his own development workflow; the development team remains responsible for technical decisions, code review and quality assurance.
basics.x-tagline: .NET modernisation, system integration and custom business software | AI-assisted software development

work.name: operandor
work.summary: Helps reduce manual work through custom business software development, modernisation of existing .NET applications and system integration. Services also include taking over existing systems and providing senior developer capacity, and he takes on technical leadership within these engagements. He also builds AI-assisted automation for clients, for example to extract data from documents, organise enquiries and search internal information, with defined human review and approval steps. AI tools used during development support his own workflow; the resulting application does not need to include AI features. His own product, rovatix, supports document processing.
highlights: Designs solution architectures, coordinates developers and takes part in implementation, code review and testing.

Works remotely with clients' existing teams, agreeing tasks, availability and responsibilities before the work starts, and brings in experienced developers he has worked with before for larger pieces of work.
Leads the development of rovatix, which reads data from PDFs, scanned documents and photos and, after a human check, passes it on in an agreed format; it is offered as a demo and an agreed pilot.

Built operandor.io, a four-language website, with Blazor WebAssembly and an Azure Functions API following Clean Architecture, tested with xUnit and deployed to Azure Static Web Apps through GitHub Actions.
Worked on an experimental .NET MAUI project within operandor.

highlights: Worked on the Intelligent Image Object Annotator R&D project, ship navigation software, a public-sector business application, and an enterprise performance and permission management system. The associated project entries detail the tasks and technologies for each project.

Developed bespoke multi-layered ERP and stock management software for an international quality assurance company.

projects.name: Modernisation of a mortgage and property transaction platform
projects.description: A business-critical platform supporting mortgage and property transactions for lenders and law firms. The multi-module enterprise system, built on .NET 10 and Clean Architecture, spanned at least six interconnected repositories and products. Worked on defining the architecture and technical direction and implementing gradual modernisation.
highlights: Reshaped a tightly coupled .NET Framework system, built on WCF and stored procedures, step by step into modular monoliths on .NET 10 with Clean Architecture, CQRS and vertical slices, migrating the legacy WCF services with the Strangler Fig pattern while the system stayed in production throughout.

Delivered a reusable access-control module, later adopted by three of the client's other products, and a reporting module fed by Azure Data Factory; the two modules were then used to build a new product.
Delivered an Azure Functions service that used Azure OpenAI to extract structured data from uploaded documents as JSON and persist it directly in the production database.

Built an internal MCP server that lets AI coding agents retrieve relevant codebase and project context from work item descriptions, using lexical, domain-specific retrieval tuned to the project's terminology.
Worked on integrating the Platform directory module across the platform and created reference implementations to guide consistent architecture.
Introduced a testing framework covering the full testing pyramid, with unit, integration and end-to-end tests accompanying both the modernisation and new features.
Drove the .NET upgrades, the CI/CD pipelines, the functional test infrastructure and comprehensive documentation.
Reviewed all of the team's pull requests, owned design reviews, ran in-depth repository audits and defined technical standards across the platform.
Mentored engineers and onboarded new joiners onto the large legacy codebase as the team grew from 3 to 7–8 people.
Handled escalated production issues on the business-critical system, from investigation through root cause analysis to remediation.
Built AI-assisted development workflows using Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and custom automation to support development across multiple repositories.

projects.name: Test reports for an accredited laboratory
projects.description: A .NET application that helped an accredited materials testing laboratory prepare its test records and reports.

Developed the test record features in .NET on a SQL Server database and built the printable test reports with DevExpress Reporting.
Supported the laboratory in meeting its accreditation requirements with the finished application.

projects.name: Supplier reporting platform
projects.description: Developed a supply-chain business intelligence system with dashboards displaying key performance indicators. The platform brought together supplier forecast confirmations and their impact on production. Led the software engineering team from initial design through deployment and worked on integrating the application's backend, frontend and data components.
highlights: Owned technical delivery across back end, front end and deployment as lead software engineer of a distributed team of 3–4 people.

Built and maintained the TypeScript/React/MUI front end consuming the BI dashboard's APIs, where leaders filtered figures by business unit, region and supplier and compared successive forecasts part by part.
Worked on an ASP.NET Core monolith following Clean Architecture, with AWS Lambda functions loading supplier data into a PostgreSQL star schema for the reports.
Owned CI/CD across Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions, with containerised deployment on Docker and Kubernetes.
Provided technical guidance and code review for the engineering team across several time zones.

highlights: Extended a large third-party .NET codebase through nopCommerce's plugin architecture, without forking it or changing the core application's source code.

x-focusProfiles.label: Software architect
x-focusProfiles.summary: Software architect with 13+ years of experience building business .NET systems, who sets the structure of a solution and then helps build it. He reshapes large, long-lived codebases step by step into modular monoliths with Clean Architecture while they stay in production, and designs modules other products can reuse, such as an access-control module adopted by three of them. Scalability, compliance and maintainability drive his decisions on Azure.

x-focusProfiles.label: .NET technical lead / full-stack developer
x-focusProfiles.summary: Technical lead and full-stack .NET engineer with 13+ years of experience, who leads small, distributed teams while writing code himself. He owns technical delivery from design and code reviews to CI/CD and production support, and onboards engineers onto large, unfamiliar codebases. He delivers C# and ASP.NET Core back ends with TypeScript/React front ends.

x-focusProfiles.label: AI-assisted development
x-focusProfiles.summary: Senior .NET developer with 13+ years of experience. He uses GitHub Copilot, Claude and Cursor in his own development workflow to support implementation, testing and documentation, and built an MCP server to provide coding agents with codebase and project context. AI-assisted workflow automation is a separate service offered to clients: he built an Azure OpenAI-based document processing service and leads the development of rovatix at operandor. He adapts business automation to existing systems and the required human review steps.

x-focusProfiles.label: Senior .NET developer (capacity)
x-focusProfiles.summary: Senior .NET developer with 13+ years of experience building business systems, available to join an existing team remotely. He is at home in large, long-lived codebases, from WCF, WPF and Windows Forms to ASP.NET Core and Azure, and traces production failures back to their root cause. Tasks, availability and responsibilities are agreed before the work starts.
